title: Minimal Scraped Recipe
description: Output contract of the scrape-recipe agent. Contains only fields that can be directly extracted from a recipe page. Enrichment agents are responsible for computing derived fields (nutrition, normalized ingredients, difficulty, etc.).

name.description: Recipe name as found on the page. Do not translate.

url.description: Canonical URL of the recipe page.

image.description: Absolute URL of the main recipe image. null if not found.

servings.description: Number of servings as stated on the page. null if not found.

prepTime.description: Prep time as a plain string, e.g. '20 minutes'. null if not stated.

cookTime.description: Cook/bake time as a plain string. null if not stated.

items.description: A single ingredient as a flat string combining amount and name. Examples: '2 cloves garlic', '200g queijo ralado', 'q.b. sal', '1 lata de tomate pelado'.

ingredients.description: Flat list of ingredient strings. Each string merges the amount and name into one readable line. Do NOT use structured objects.

items.description: A single preparation step. One instruction per array entry.

tags.description: Category or label tags found on the page. Always include the source site's domain slug as a tag so recipes can be grouped by origin.

examples.name: Cogumelos recheados
ingredients: q.b. Queijo ralado ou Queijo da ilha ralado
steps: Comece por limpar os cogumelos, retire os pés e coloque-os num tabuleiro, adicione uma pitada de sal e um fio de azeite. Leve a assar cerca de 15 mins a 200ºC.
Enquanto os cogumelos estão no forno, numa taça coloque o queijo creme, o salmão fumado, o alho em pó e o cebolinho. Envolva bem.
Coloque o recheio por cima dos cogumelos, junte queijo ralado e um fio de azeite. Leve ao forno a gratinar cerca de 10 mins no forno, na máxima temperatura.
